title: lavandula pedunculata subsp. sampaioana
intro: Lavandula pedunculata subsp. sampaioana, commonly known as Sampaio's Lavender, is a subspecies of the Lavandula pedunculata plant, a type of flowering plant in the mint family that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its aromatic flowers and leaves, which have been used for centuries in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Sampaio's Lavender include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and soothe skin irritations, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as sedative, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include linalool, linalyl acetate, and camphor, which contribute to its calming and healing effects.
